item.title: Stockton Police Department introduces new K9 officer, Mali
item.description: STOCKTON, Mo. — The Stockton Police Department has welcomed a new four-legged officer to its ranks. K9 Mali, a Belgian Malinois, joins the force after completing extensive training in patrol operations, suspect apprehension, tracking and narcotics detection. Mali, who holds the honorary rank of lieutenant, will be partnered with Sgt. Adam Marshall, a certified K9 [...]

item.title: Jupiter will shine brighter than ever this weekend: Here's how to see it
item.description: On Saturday night, Jupiter will become in perfect alignment with the Earth and Sun causing the planet to appear the biggest and brightest it will be all year.

item.title: Winter cold slowly starting to creep back
item.description: Temperatures will be fluctuating over the next few days, with a cold Sunday followed by a warm-up on Monday and Tuesday, before winter air returns in the second half of the week.

item.title: 'I do not hear her anymore. I do not know what he did to her'; Details of the Springfield homicide
item.description: Felipe Ayala was arrested and charged with first-degree murder and armed criminal action after his wife, Suzette Flores, was found dead in the garage of their home with blunt force trauma to her head and face.
